I replied to Florian in his DM to confirm that Bay 28 is now his dock for Sableness Tire Supply pickups on the Larchmont project. His message is already saved in gbrain as a fact, and I didn't change anything else.

You should check one thing: gbrain stores private DMs as visible only to their author, but this one is labeled `"visibility": "world"`. It does sit under a private source (`private-florian-lorthorpe`). I didn't change the setting. If that label means other members can retrieve it, someone with admin access to gbrain should look at it. I won't use it in anyone else's conversations either way.
